steps.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by 5%. Each time the wearer casts their Ultimate, nearby allies restore HP equal to 25% of the wearer's ATK plus 8% of the target's lost HP.

guide.text: Starfire's signature gear. Increases her Attack when she casts her Ultimate and heals nearby allies, which is a rare source of healing from gear. Her Ultimate also boosts allies' Attack, while each cast stacks her own Attack, allowing Starfire to protect and empower the team simultaneously.
